item.title: Workbless Pressure Washers Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Shock and Electrocution Hazards
item.company: Amazon.com, BestBuy, Kohls, Lowe's, Overstock, Target and Walmart from April 2025 through July 2026 for between $97 and $140.
item.brand: Amazon.com, BestBuy, Kohls, Lowe's, Overstock, Target and Walmart from April 2025 through July 2026 for between $97 and $140.
item.summary: This recall involves Workbless-branded pressure washers, models WB0301 and WB0302. Model WB0301 is green and black and measures about 27.24 inches high, 10.83 inches wide and 8.39 inches deep. "WORKBLESS"," WB0301" and "ELECTRIC PRESSURE WASHER" are printed on a label on the back of the pressure washer. Model WB0302 is also green and black and measures about 29.57 inches high, 14.69 inches wide and 10.94 inches deep. "WORKBLESS", "WB0302" and "HEAVY DUTY ELECTRIC PRESSURE WASHER" are printed on a label on the back of the pressure washer. Both models came with four quick connect nozzles and a foam cannon.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Workbless Electric Pressure Washers.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled pressure washers immediately and contact Workbless for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the pressure washer by cutting the unplugged power cord in half and send a photo of the destroyed pressure washer to service@workbless.net. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed recalled product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
